reconstruction_notes.en: A true longitudinal sediment cutaway exposes a gently zigzag route joined to seven short angled J-shaped probes. Half-round channel voids and the upper interface make internal connections visible. Original teaching layout; no named maker, behavior or copied specimen.

section_structure.presentation: Illustrative longitudinal vertical cutaway removes near half of the sediment/burrows. True recessed half-round channels expose the connected internal route and angled J junctions; one probe reaches the illustrated upper interface.

trace_scope: original schematic internal section of serial near-end joined J/downbowed probes; no excavated specimen, named producer, feeding/locomotion mechanism or exact spatial reconstruction
geometry_note: A single continuous closed sediment mesh includes real channel voids in its cut face. Uniform material; no painted network or free-floating positive-relief tubes. Layout, depth and exposure are artistic teaching choices.

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: a zigzag route links successive short j-shaped probes at angled junctions. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: sectional-structure; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
